name: Camden Property Trust (MyCamden)
notes: Researched from Camden's public 'Camden Living Simplified' resident FAQ (camdenliving.com) and the public MyCamden.com landing page (community picker 'Select your community' before sign-in). MyCamden: pay rent, view balance, set up Autopay, payment history, e-receipts by email, service requests (also by text, email, call or office visit; 24/7 emergency maintenance). Lease cancellation at most communities: 60 days' notice plus a one-month-rent cancellation fee; transfers need 90 days' residence + 30 days' written notice. Website help 713-354-2500 (24x7). Payment methods/fees not stated on the FAQ (catalog note: e-check free, card fees apply - not modelled). Sign-in fields not observed. REVIEW 2026-10-09 (independent reviewer): verified the FAQ blog and MyCamden.com (community picker labelled Community List / Select your community; no sign-in fields until a community is chosen). Rewrote the renters-insurance article from the FAQ (eRenterPlan pre-approval) instead of generic filler. Public nav item renamed from 'Select your community' to 'MyCamden Login': the mock login page has no community picker, so the old label promised a control the page lacks (template has no picker; see cross-owner request).

pay_online.note: Pay rent and view your balance at MyCamden; an e-receipt is emailed as soon as you pay.

autopay.note: Set up Autopay in MyCamden so rent is never late.

cancel_service.note: Most communities require 60 days' notice and a lease cancellation fee of one month's rent.

help.title: Paying rent at MyCamden
paragraphs: Paying online at MyCamden is the simplest way to pay rent and see your balance. Pay with your preferred method, set up Autopay so you never miss a due date, review your payment history, and get an e-receipt by email as soon as you pay.
On MyCamden.com, first select your community, then sign in.

help.title: Requesting service
paragraphs: The fastest way to request service is to log in to MyCamden. You can also text, email, call or visit the office, and maintenance is on call 24/7 for urgent problems.

help.title: Cancelling or transferring your lease
paragraphs: Most Camden communities require 60 days' notice to cancel a lease plus a cancellation fee equal to one month's rent. To transfer to another Camden community you must have lived in your apartment at least 90 days, give 30 days' written notice and get leasing office approval.

help.title: Renters insurance
paragraphs: Camden residents are pre-approved for eRenterPlan renters insurance. You can sign up online, and the policy is sent to your leasing office automatically. MyCamden.com also links to the eRenterPlan quote page.

help.title: Contact Camden
paragraphs: Call 713-354-2500 any time for help using the website. Your leasing office handles transfers, cancellations, pest control enrollment and pet policies; the front office can explain your community's package delivery system.

extra.intent: Using the Camden help pages, find the usual lease cancellation fee and notice period. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
